topics.title: Spesolimab (1368-0140) Capsayil Ph3 PG – Recruitment Challenges & Actions

background.text: Capsayil Ph3 PG study 1368-0140: recruitment timeline extended ~4 months on Sep 4; total screened target changed to 206 from 134; LSR changed to Oct 2026 (global) / Aug 2026 (China) from Jun/Apr 2026; DBL changed to Feb 2028 from Oct 2027. As of Dec 5: Global 98 screened, 29 randomized, 65 screen failed; China 20 screened, 5 randomized, 15 screen failed.
background.quote:
Recruitment status as of 5Dec:
Global: 98 (+4) patients screened, 29 randomized (+4), 65 screen failed, 4 in screening.
China: 20  patients screened, 5 randomized (+1), 15 screen failed, 0 in screening.

todo.text: Recruitment boost actions (owner/status not stated in source): leading site/PI on-site visit Dec 2, 2025; on-site visits to CHN2 (Nov 10) and CHN10 (Nov 14); 2nd round CRA workshop Nov 3, 2025; MSL activities, media outreach, investigator exchange forums (原文未说明 owner、completed 状态).
todo.quote:
